summary: Yiren Digital filed a Form 6-K announcing the engagement of Marcum Asia CPAs LLP as its new independent registered public accounting firm, effective June 1, 2026, replacing Wei, Wei Co., LLP. The change was approved by the audit committee and board. No financial terms, stake, premium, or deal mechanics are involved. This is a routine auditor change that does not constitute a special situation like activist campaigns, M&A, or management upheaval.
